From: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@starlight.io>

Cc: procure@starlight.io
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial PO request + onboarding form

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the walkthrough today — Starlight is excited to get started. Attached is our completed onboarding form and a high-level invoice we expect for month one. Two quick asks to make sure procurement has what you need: 

1) Will Redwood be able to issue a provisional PO number while we finalize spend bands? We typically need a PO to attach the purchase order for our downstream systems.
2) Can you confirm the spend cap buckets available (monthly vs. committed) and whether we can split line items across those buckets?

I attached the onboarding form (Starlight_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and a brief SKU mapping that shows how we'll split charges. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Gomez
Head of Procurement, Starlight Analytics
anna.gomez@starlight.io
procure@starlight.io

Attachments: Starlight_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf), sku_lineitem_mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@starlight.io>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO request + onboarding form

Hi Anna — thanks for sending everything through. Quick answers: 

- We can issue a provisional PO number (PO-9987-PROV) that you can attach immediately. It will be used for initial provisioning and invoice routing while we finalize committed spend buckets.
- Spend cap options: monthly-usage (no commit) or 3/6/12 month committed tiers. For billing we can allocate line items to different buckets, but ledger codes must be specified per line so finance can route correctly.

I've started a short internal thread to get finance to confirm ledger mappings and to upload the PO draft to our Drive. Mina — can you confirm whether PO-9987-PROV can be issued immediately and if finance needs any additional merchant codes from Starlight? Marissa — FYI on SKU mapping and whether we should request a corrected line-level description back from the vendor.

Connor O'Brien
Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference

Connor — I can issue the provisional PO now. Finance needs the following to lock the final PO number:

- Official vendor legal name and remit address (from the onboarding form) — already present.
- Merchant code per line item or a dominant merchant code if they want a single bucket.
- Expected monthly spend band (approximate) to set temporary spend cap — please ask vendor to pick one of: <$10k, $10k-50k, $50k-200k, >$200k.

I'll put the provisional PO-9987-PROV into our PO system and upload the PO draft (PO_Draft_9987.pdf) to the onboarding folder. One note: the SKU spreadsheet uses three-letter internal SKUs that don't match our ledger descriptions; ask vendor to provide human-readable line descriptions for each SKU so we can avoid line-item rejects during invoice processing.

1) Vendor to confirm the human-readable line descriptions for the three SKUs (Anna — received your file, thanks; please add the short descriptions in column D so our AP parser can consume).
